title: My Home
subtitle: The people in your home
intro: Everyone who can sign in to your smart home. Add family and guests, set a new password when someone forgets theirs, or pause someone's access.
load_failed: Couldn't load the people in your home.
owner_note: The owner's account can't be changed here.
maintenance_note: Dartec's support account is also on this home, so we can look after it. It isn't a member of your household and can't be changed here. You decide when Dartec may make changes with the "Allow Dartec support" switch.

role_help.admin: Can use everything, change settings, add devices and manage the people in your home.
role_help.family: Can use all the devices and dashboards. Can't change settings or manage people.
role_help.guest: For visitors, and for staff who stay a while. Can only sign in when they are at home. Pause them when they leave.

guest_honest: While they're signed in, guests can still see and control every device, like any family member. Home Assistant can't limit a person to some devices.
view_only_help: Your installer set this person up as view only. Choose a role to change it.

form.name: Name
form.name_hint: How they'll appear in the home, for example "Layla"
form.username_hint: What they type to sign in. Letters, numbers, dots or dashes.
form.local_only: Can only sign in at home
form.local_only_help: They can sign in only on your home's Wi-Fi, never from outside.
form.local_only_guest: Guests can always only sign in at home.
form.local_only_self: You can't change where you yourself can sign in.
form.role_self: You can't change your own role. Ask someone else who can manage the home.
form.dashboard_note: This sets what they see first; it doesn't hide devices from them.

actions.password_owner_only: Only the home's owner can set someone else's password.
actions.password_self: To change your own password, open your profile.
actions.self_limits: This is you. You can change your name and first dashboard here.
actions.self_owner: This is you, the home's owner. Change your password from your profile; here you can choose your first dashboard.

password.title: New password for {name}
password.sign_out: Also sign them out on all their devices
password.sign_out_help: Do this if the old password might be known to someone else.
password.confirm_body: Their old password stops working straight away.

done.share: Give them these details. You won't see the password here again.
done.app_hint: They can sign in on this home's address, or in the Home Assistant app.

confirm.pause_body: {name} is signed out on every device and can't sign in until you resume. Nothing else changes.
confirm.remove_body: {name} won't be able to sign in any more, and they're taken off the list of who's home. Your devices, automations and history stay as they are. This can't be undone.

about.title: About roles and dashboards
about.roles: Family (can manage the home) is Home Assistant's administrator. Family is a regular user. A guest is a regular user who can only sign in at home.
about.dashboards: Choosing a first dashboard is a convenience, not a lock. Anyone who can sign in can still open the other dashboards and control every device.
about.log: Every change here is written to your home's logbook, with who made it.

errors.not_found: That person is no longer on this home.
errors.owner: The owner's account can't be changed here.
errors.maintenance: Dartec's support account isn't managed here.
errors.system: This account belongs to Home Assistant itself.
errors.actor_maintenance: Dartec's support account can't manage your household.
errors.actor_not_admin: Only people who can manage the home can do this.
errors.username_invalid: Usernames are 2 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or number.
errors.username_reserved: That username is reserved for Dartec.
errors.username_taken: Someone on this home already has that username.
errors.password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.password_personal: The password can't contain their name or username.
errors.password_simple: That password is too easy to guess.
errors.password_weak: Choose a stronger password, or tap "Make one for me".
errors.own_role: You can't change your own role. Ask someone else who can manage the home.
errors.self_local: You can't change where you yourself can sign in.
errors.own_password: To change your own password, open your profile.
errors.owner_only: Only the home's owner can set someone else's password.
errors.no_login: This person signs in another way and has no password here.
errors.last_admin: Someone has to be able to manage the home. Give another person that role first.
errors.dashboard_unknown: That dashboard isn't on this home any more.
errors.loopback: The household can only be managed by someone signed in to this home.
errors.unauthorized: Only people who can manage the home can open this.
